lesson_card.plain_english: the advantage a lab builds when its model, data, distribution, and ecosystem make it hard to replace
lesson_card.big_question: Is the best model enough, or is the real moat distribution and control?
lesson_card.simple_analogy: a castle built from distribution, data, habit, and switching costs instead of stone
lesson_card.common_misunderstanding: People focus on the launch. The useful question is who gains control, who inherits risk, and what changes tomorrow.
lesson_card.listener_payoff: By the end, listeners should understand model moat well enough to explain why today's AI story matters tomorrow.
lesson_card.operator_lesson: Do not ask only what launched. Ask what new permission, risk, cost, or accountability chain just appeared.
lesson_card.episode_spine: Today’s stories are not five separate headlines; they are evidence of one AI leverage shift.
